name: Artifact Debug Agent
description: Creates and converts debug artifacts so artifact references, routing, and UI rendering can be validated end-to-end.

skills.name: Create SVG Artifact
skills.description: Generate an SVG image artifact containing a user-provided word and register it as a conversation artifact reference.
skills.usage_notes: Use this to create a deterministic test artifact for downstream artifact-aware skills.
skills.output_format: JSON with status, artifact metadata, and artifact_id

word.description: Word or short phrase to render in the SVG.

name.description: Optional output filename. '.svg' will be enforced.

background_color.description: Optional background color (CSS color or hex value, e.g. 'white', '#f8fafc').

color.description: Optional text color (CSS color or hex value, e.g. 'blue', '#1e40af').

skills.name: Convert SVG To PNG
skills.description: Convert an existing SVG artifact into a PNG artifact. Only use this when the user explicitly requests a PNG or raster image conversion of an existing SVG — do NOT chain this automatically after create_svg_artifact.
skills.usage_notes: Requires artifact_id of an existing SVG artifact in the current conversation. Only invoke when the user explicitly asks to convert to PNG.
skills.output_format: JSON with status, source artifact metadata, and converted PNG artifact metadata

artifact_id.description: Artifact ID of the SVG to convert.

name.description: Optional output filename. '.png' will be enforced.

description.description: Optional human-readable description for the generated PNG artifact.

skills.name: Create JSON Artifact
skills.description: Create an inline JSON artifact with an explicit json_type so frontend JSON rendering and artifact catalog ingestion can be validated.
skills.usage_notes: Use this to validate native A2A structured artifact handling. Provide a stable json_type and an object payload.
skills.output_format: JSON with status, artifact metadata, artifact_id, and json_type

json_type.description: Structured JSON visualization type identifier, e.g. 'prometheus.debug.echo.v1'.

payload.description: JSON object to store inline in the artifact.

name.description: Optional display name for the JSON artifact.
